<b>Atacar:</b> sobre el rival aparece un: Attack: a rose of five zones appears over the opponent. Put the cursor on the zone you want to strike from and click. The centre is the thrust. Also 8 4 6 2 5 on the numeric keypad.
<b>Finta:</b> mientras preparas el golpe: Feint: while winding up the blow, click another zone to change it (up to halfway through the wind-up; it costs stamina).
<b>Parar:</b> mantén el botón derecho o: Parry: hold the right button or Space. You don't need to choose a side.
<b>Arco y piedras:</b> mantén el botón i: Bow and stones: hold the left button to draw, aim and release. The circle closes as you draw and turns green when ready; if you hold too long it shakes.
Joystick a la izquierda para moverte; ce: Joystick on the left to move; near the opponent the sides circle around him. Two fingers turn the camera.
<b>Atacar:</b> toca una zona de la rosa: Attack: tap a zone of the rose that appears over the opponent. The centre is the thrust. Tapping another zone while winding up is a feint.
<b>Arco y piedras:</b> mantén el dedo pa: Bow and stones: hold your finger to draw, drag to aim and release.
<b>Parada:</b> mantener Parar detiene cu: Parry: holding Parry stops any blow, but it tires you. When exhausted (95%), it gives way.
<b>Escudo</b> (arma «Espada y escudo»):: Shield (weapon “Sword and shield”): it rises when you parry; it also stops arrows and stones coming from the front and tires you less than parrying with the sword. The one-handed sword reaches a little less than the longsword.
<b>Parada perfecta:</b> empieza a parar: Perfect parry: start parrying just before the impact (zone in green on apprentice). The opponent is thrown off balance and your counterattack comes out fast and can only be stopped by another perfect parry.
<b>Golpe maestro:</b> si ves venir un go: Master strike: if you see a blow coming from one side (zone in red), strike from that same side early in his wind-up (golden edge). You deflect his blow and yours lands.
En <b>aprendiz</b> los golpes son lentos: On apprentice blows are slow and you see the side and the timing. On normal you only see the side. On realistic there are no cues: you have to read the opponent's body.
Los círculos de la derecha avisan de can: The circles on the right warn of fatigue, bleeding and wounds. Tap them to see their effect.
Terreno llano en este hito. Las cuestas: Flat terrain in this milestone. Slopes and their effect on foundations come with the generated world.
Los materiales vienen dados (y hay botón: Materials are given (and there's a button to refill them). Gathering them comes in milestone 2.
Para construir hace falta tu mojón; la t: Building requires your boundary stone; your land is a 20 m circle (level 1 stone). Upgrading the stone comes later.
La primera pieza estructural fija la rej: The first structural piece sets the grid: position where you aim and free rotation in 15° steps. Any piece within 6 m of a building snaps to its grid.
Los apoyos siguen un orden realista: un: Supports follow a realistic order: a wall rests first on the wall or beam below it, otherwise on posts at both ends, and otherwise on the floor or foundation beside it.
La carga se reparte a partes iguales ent: The load is shared equally among each piece's supports.
Al desmontar recuperas el 75% de esa pie: Dismantling gives back 75% of that piece. Whatever collapses on top of it is destroyed and returns no material.
Si al desmontar una pieza otra quedaría: If dismantling a piece would overload another (not leave it unsupported, but carrying too much weight), the dismantling is blocked and the piece that would fail is marked.
Los muros que quedan debajo de un tejado: Walls under a roof close up to it on their own, in the same material: gables no longer need to be placed by hand (the piece has been removed from the menu).
Cada tramo de tejado sube 1,2 m en sus 2: Each roof section rises 1.2 m over its 2 m. Consecutive sections in the same direction form one continuous slope; two facing sections form the ridge.
Las piezas que no aguantan peso (cercas,: Pieces that bear no weight (fences, palisades, half walls) never count as support for others. A roof section can only hold up the roof section next to it.
v4 (Pedro: «la madera es demasiado débil: v4 (Pedro: “wood is too weak”): wood now holds quite a lot more. A two-storey log house with a roof can be built without tricks and without any piece going over 75%; three storeys need a stone foundation; wattle can't carry two storeys.
v4: vano de una casilla. Un suelo en alt: v4: one-cell span. A raised floor or roof section with no walls below rests on the neighbouring floor or section that does have them. So a house of up to 4×4 cells needs no beams inside; from 5×5 upwards, the centre does.
v4: lo que aguanta cada pieza (kg): cimi: v4: what each piece holds (kg): stone foundation 6000, log 2000; log wall 1200 (with doorway 850, with window 1000), timber frame 1400, planks 900 (with doorway 600), wattle 250; post 2000, beam 1000; log floor 900, plank floor 1000. All provisional, for you to adjust.
La decoración no suma peso a la estructu: Furnishings add no weight to the structure.
Escalera de mano: se usa con el botón Us: Ladder: use it with the Use button to go up or down a floor if there's a floor above.
Los muros de troncos van en 10 hiladas d: Log walls are laid in 10 courses of 25 cm: they all end at 2.5 m and their logs line up in height. The doorway is 2 m tall (8 courses) and the window runs from 1 to 1.75 m.
La partida se guarda sola en el navegado: The game saves itself in the browser (with a button to restart).
v2, por qué: en la v1 había que arrastra: v2, why: in v1 you had to drag the mouse to choose the blow and also choose the parry line, and the camera and movement did their own thing. It has been redone taking what works best in reference fencing games: a rose of strikes, perfect parry, master strike, counterattack, feint, directionless parry at low difficulty and physical weight to the blows.
Atacar: sobre el rival aparece una rosa: Attack: a rose of five zones appears over the opponent (high, left, right, low and thrust in the centre). You aim with the cursor or tap the zone and strike. Left and right are those of your screen.
Defensa en tres capas. Parada: mantener: Defence in three layers. Parry: holding Parry stops any blow without choosing a side, but costs stamina. Perfect parry: starting to parry in the last 0.25 s before impact throws the opponent off balance for 0.7 s and opens 0.8 s for a counterattack.
El contraataque se prepara un 40% más rá: The counterattack winds up 40% faster and can only be stopped by another perfect parry.
Golpe maestro: si golpeas por el mismo l: Master strike: if you strike from the same side the blow is coming from during the first half of its wind-up, you deflect his and yours comes out almost at once (also unstoppable except by a perfect parry).
Finta: mientras preparas, elegir otra zo: Feint: while winding up, choosing another zone changes the blow, up to 60% of the wind-up. It costs stamina. It works against someone who parries too early.
Aliento: atacar, parar, fintar, mantener: Stamina: attacking, parrying, feinting, holding the parry and missing blows tire you. Above 70% blows come out slower; at 95% your parry gives way.
Dificultad = ritmo + ayudas. Aprendiz: g: Difficulty = pace + aids. Apprentice: blows 60% slower and the rose shows you the side of the incoming blow (red), when to parry (green) and when a master strike fits (golden edge). Normal: 25% slower, you only see the side. Realistic: real speed and no cues.
Movimiento encarado: cerca del rival, ad: Facing movement: near the opponent, forward and back close in or pull away, and the sides circle around him without looking away.
Cámara con margen: solo se recoloca si e: Camera with slack: it only repositions if the opponent goes well out of frame, and leaves you alone for 3 s after you turn it yourself.
Peso de los golpes: pausa de 50 a 100 ms: Weight of blows: a 50 to 100 ms pause on each clash, sparks when steel meets steel, blood on wounding, recoil of the one hit, a slight camera shake, a blade trail and synthesised sounds (they can be turned off in Options).
Las guardias de la v1 siguen en el códig: The guards from v1 remain in the code as an advanced mode but are not in the menu: on first contact they confused more than they added.
Espada larga: tajo 1,9 m de alcance y 0,: Longsword: cut with 1.9 m reach and 0.42 s wind-up at real pace; thrust 2.15 m and 0.32 s. Staff: 1.5 m, slower and blunt.
Heridas por zona y gravedad (leve, grave: Wounds by zone and severity (light, serious, critical) with no health bars. Critical to the head takes you out of the fight. The torso bleeds heavily. Wounded sword arm: slower, weaker blows. Wounded leg: slower and limping. Light cuts stop bleeding on their own; blunt blows bleed little but stun.
Armaduras: el gambesón reduce el tajo a: Armour: the gambeson halves a cut; mail almost cancels it, but stops thrusts and blunt blows less well.
v3, arreglo provisional del arco (pedido: v3, provisional bow fix (requested by Pedro after trying it): releasing below half draw cancels the shot without firing; breaking into a run eases the bow and you can't start drawing while running; after each shot there are 0.8 s to draw and nock the next arrow (0.5 s to pick up another stone). Before, you could run and shoot non-stop.
v4, escudo PROVISIONAL (pedido por Pedro: v4, PROVISIONAL shield (requested by Pedro; he will review it): new weapon “Sword and shield”. One-handed sword: 1.7 m reach (longsword 1.9), thrust 1.9 m, winds up a little faster (0.38 s) and wounds a little less. Round plank shield with a leather rim and a boss, on the left arm; when parrying it rises in front.
v4: con escudo, Parar también detiene fl: v4: with a shield, Parry also stops arrows and stones coming from the front (70° to each side of where you face); from behind or the side it doesn't. Parrying with a shield costs 60% of the stamina it costs with the sword. The perfect parry and master strike work the same.
v4: nueva opción «Arma del rival» (como: v4: new option “Opponent's weapon” (same as yours, longsword, sword and shield or staff). An opponent with a shield raises it when you aim at him with a bow or sling and keeps it up while you reload.
Arco: tensar del todo tarda 1 s. El círc: Bow: a full draw takes 1 s. The aiming circle closes as you draw and turns green at full draw; if you release earlier, the arrow falls short. After 2.5 s at full draw your hand shakes and the circle opens in red. Arrows can't be parried with the sword; with a shield, they can (v4).
El rival de la máquina tarda en reaccion: The computer opponent takes time to react and, depending on difficulty, reads your blows better and tries perfect parries, master strikes and feints. He stands still while striking and sometimes steps back afterwards. Your band is blue and his is yellow.
Textos de la interfaz en español e inglé: Interface texts in Spanish and English (button at the top right); Russian is prepared and will come later.
v5: textos en español e inglés (botón ar: v5: texts in Spanish and English (button at the top right); Russian is prepared and will come later.

v6: escalera de tablas (6 tablas y 6 cla: v6: plank stairs (6 planks and 6 nails, 100 kg). They take one tile and you climb them by walking, no button: you step in on the low side and come out at the top onto the next tile (rotate with R to choose which way they rise). The opening above must stay open, so no floor can go there. They need a foundation or floor below, or bare ground on the ground floor.
v6: por el hueco de la escalera se puede: v6: you can drop down onto the stairs through their opening from above; railings to close it come in the next task. You can walk under the high end without climbing.
